title: Ninu Matrame Ne Nammanaya – John J Telugu Christian Lyrics
english: Krupa choopuvaadavayyaa nee pillalaku krupa choopuvaadavayyaa
translation: I have trusted in You alone, my Lord
You alone are my courage, Jesus!
The strength of Your mighty arm will guide me
And it will set all my situations right.
You are the one who shows grace, Oh Lord, to Your children, You show grace.
1. When You command, what is it that cannot come into existence?
When You send Your Word, what is it that cannot happen?
Everything belongs to You, Oh glorious and wealthy Lord,
I will sing praises to You!
You are the provider who gathers everything for Your children, You provide everything.
2. When You go ahead of me, who can ever stand against me?
When You work, who can ever block or hinder it?
The battle belongs to You, Oh mighty Warrior,
I will move forward with confidence!
You are the one who gives victory to Your children, You grant us victory.
3. When You show mercy, who can deny it?
When You fill me with power, who can defeat me?
The help comes entirely from You, my Helper,
I will hide myself safely in You!
You are the one who gives strength to Your children, You grant us strength.
intro: Ninu Matrame Ne Nammanaya is the latest Telugu Christian song written by John J. This song was released on June 28, 2026, through Piyu Worship Studio YouTube Channel.
